title: Square Panel Luxury Bed – Upholstered Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Square Panel Luxury Bed is an upholstered bed frame for people who like their bedroom tidy and architectural. The headboard is built from structured square panels with generous padding, and the whole frame is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Structured square-panel headboard
  • Generously padded upholstery throughout
  • Solid timber slatted base
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £292.99; Small Double (4FT) £318.99; Double (4FT6) £337.99; King (5FT) £376.99; Super King (6FT) £415.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses and pick the firmness that suits you.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What is a square panel bed frame?

It is a bed frame with a headboard made from square padded panels, which gives the bed a structured, tailored look. This one sits on a solid timber slatted base and is upholstered by hand in Dewsbury.

What style of room does the Square Panel Bed suit?

The straight, square panel lines suit minimalist and modern bedrooms best, though in a deep velvet it also works in a more traditional room.

Is the base solid or sprung?

The bed sits on a solid timber slatted base, so you only need to add a mattress in the size you choose.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.

See also: upholstered beds, how to choose an upholstered bed.
